title: Grilled Beef Skewers with Brazilian Chimichurri
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring juicy beef skewers served with a tangy and herby Brazilian-style chimichurri sauce.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, whisk together garlic, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
3. Add the beef to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
4. Thread the beef onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
6. Meanwhile, prepare the chimichurri sauce by combining red pepper flakes, oregano, garlic, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
7. Stir in 1/4 cup of olive oil and 2 tablespoons of red wine vinegar.
8. Once the skewers are cooked, let them rest for 5 minutes before serving with the chimichurri sauce.
